bio.text: Rachel Keshel is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 17, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.
According to her campaign website, Keshel has lived in Arizona for 17 years and is the mother of five children, three of whom were adopted.
The website says she earned a degree in Business Management and worked as a business executive at a UPS facility, then became a teacher and later director of a preschool.
